hedging_delta.evidence: Similar use of 'expect', 'anticipate' in both calls' guidance sections.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Q3 revenue $32.5B (up ~8% seq implied); current guides Q4 at $37.5B, up ~7% sequential, a deceleration in guided sequential growth rate.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Software/SaaS run-rate guided to 'approach $2B' exiting year in both calls; unchanged, but current annualizing only $1.5B now vs prior 'approach $2B' pace implied stronger trajectory.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New emphasis on AI-RAN/telecom (SoftBank, T-Mobile) and reasoning models like OpenAI's o1 not present in prior call.

tone_delta.evidence: Prior called Blackwell demand 'well above supply' and 'strong'; current calls it 'staggering' but revenue growth rates (94% YoY vs 122% YoY) show deceleration despite superlatives.

demand_language_delta.evidence: Data center YoY growth decelerated from 154% (prior) to 112% (current), and overall revenue growth from 122% to 94% YoY.
